sections.label: Continuous Play (AutoDJ)
sections.description: Automatically extends the play queue with a track by an artist similar to what's currently playing, once the queue is about to run out. Uses the Last.fm API for similarity data and your local library for matching tracks; for artists not in your library it can also use TIDAL, Qobuz, HIGHRESAUDIO or Spotify if they are set up in Volumio (switches below).

content.label: Enabled
content.description: Turn continuous play on or off. Requires a Last.fm API key below.

content.label: Check interval (seconds)
content.doc: How often to check the queue and, if needed, add a track. Minimum 30 seconds.

content.label: Last.fm API key
content.doc: Free API key from https://www.last.fm/api/account/create - used to find artists similar to what's currently playing.

content.label: Artist repeat guard size
content.doc: How many recently-used artists to remember and avoid repeating right away. If none of the similar artists found for the current track are outside this list, the guard is overridden rather than letting the queue run dry. The exact same TRACK is separately guarded for longer (15 additions), regardless of this setting - see the volumio-autodj README.

content.label: Auto volume normalization
content.description: Turns Volumio's volume normalization on once AutoDJ starts mixing artists into the queue, and back off at the next freshly-started queue. Off by default - leave off if you manage this setting yourself. If you change it manually while AutoDJ is running, that change is respected until the next fresh queue.

content.label: Auto crossfade (seconds)
content.doc: Turns MPD's crossfade on with this many seconds once AutoDJ starts mixing artists into the queue, and back off (0) at the next freshly-started queue - same on/off behavior as Auto volume normalization above, including respecting a manual change until the next fresh queue. Leave empty to disable (default) and manage crossfade yourself.

content.label: Exclude keywords
content.doc: Semicolon-separated words/phrases, e.g. "Live;Tubular Bells;Ommadawn" - any candidate track whose title OR album contains one of these, case-insensitively, is skipped entirely. Handy for keeping live recordings or specific long-form albums out of the mix. Plain substring match, not a full filter - a short word can have false positives ("Live" also matches an album called "Olive Grove"). Leave empty to disable (default).

content.label: Use TIDAL
content.description: If an artist similar to the current one is not in your local library, also look for their tracks on TIDAL. Only has an effect if TIDAL is set up as a music source in Volumio. A local match always wins. If several services have the artist, the first one in this list is used.

content.label: Use Qobuz
content.description: If an artist similar to the current one is not in your local library, also look for their tracks on Qobuz. Only has an effect if Qobuz is set up as a music source in Volumio. A local match always wins.

content.label: Use HIGHRESAUDIO
content.description: If an artist similar to the current one is not in your local library, also look for their tracks on HIGHRESAUDIO. Only has an effect if HIGHRESAUDIO is set up as a music source in Volumio. A local match always wins.

content.label: Use Spotify
content.description: If an artist similar to the current one is not in your local library, also look for their tracks on Spotify. Only has an effect if Spotify is set up as a music source in Volumio. A local match always wins. Needs Volumio's Spotify plugin with search (Spotify Connect alone has none).
